# Raw data

### Libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(here)
library(readxl)
library(janitor)
library(readr)
library(purrr)
library(zipcodeR)
library(tidygeocoder)
```

### Data
```{r}
# 2024 information
address_24 <- read_excel(here("data/raw/pp_2024/pp_address__1.xlsx")) %>% clean_names()

pp_24 <- read_excel(here("data/raw/pp_2024/pp_names__1.xlsx")) %>% clean_names()

products <- read_excel(here("data/raw/pp_2024/PPS1999to2024.xlsx")) %>% clean_names()
  

```



# 2024 Active States

## Geocode zips
processors listed as active IN 2024 DATA
```{r}
# Filter to active processors
active_processors_24 <- address_24 %>%
  filter(status == "A")

print(unique(active_processors_24$plant_state_abrv))

write_csv(active_processors_24, here("data/cleaned/states-2024/active-processors-2024.csv"))

# Make file for each state with active processors
active_processors_24 %>%
  split(.$plant_state_abrv) %>%
  iwalk(~ write_csv(
    .x,
    here(
      "data",
      "cleaned",
      "states-2024",
      paste0((.y), ".csv")
  )))


# Get all state files
active_state_files <- list.files(
  here("data","cleaned", "states-2024"),
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

# Collect all unique ZIP codes across all files
active_zips <- map_dfr(
  active_state_files,
  ~ read_csv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      transmute(
        plant_zip = str_pad(
          as.character(plant_zip),
          width = 5,
          pad = "0"
        )
      )
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(plant_zip), plant_zip != "") %>%
  distinct()

# Geocode each ZIP once
active_zip_geo <- geocode_zip(active_zips$plant_zip)

# Process each state file
process_active_state_file <- function(file, active_zip_geo) {

  dat <- read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(
      plant_zip = str_pad(
        as.character(plant_zip),
        width = 5,
        pad = "0"
      )
    )

  dat_geo <- dat %>%
    left_join(
      active_zip_geo,
      by = c("plant_zip" = "zipcode")
    )

  output_file <- here(
    "data",
    "cleaned",
    "states-2024-zipgeo",
    paste0(
      tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file)),
      "-zipgeo.csv"
    )
  )

  write_csv(dat_geo, output_file)

  message("Finished: ", basename(file))
}

# Run for all states
walk(
  active_state_files,
  process_active_state_file,
  active_zip_geo = active_zip_geo
)
```



## Geocode full address
```{r}
# Read in (or create) geocode cache
cache_file <- here("data", "cleaned", "geocode_cache.csv")

if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
  geocode_cache <- read_csv(cache_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
} else {
  geocode_cache <- tibble(
    full_address = character(),
    latitude = double(),
    longitude = double()
  )
}


# Get all active state files
active_state_files <- list.files(
  here("data", "cleaned", "states-2024"),
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

# Function to process one file
process_active_state_file_street <- function(file) {

  dat <- read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(
      plant_zip = str_pad(as.character(plant_zip), 5, pad = "0"),
      full_address = paste(
        plant_street,
        plant_city,
        plant_state_abrv,
        plant_zip,
        sep = ", "
      ),
      full_address = na_if(full_address, "NA, NA, NA, NA")
    )

  # Find addresses not already cached
  new_addresses <- dat %>%
    distinct(full_address) %>%
    filter(!is.na(full_address)) %>%
    anti_join(geocode_cache, by = "full_address")

  # Geocode only new addresses
  if (nrow(new_addresses) > 0) {

    message("Geocoding ", nrow(new_addresses), " new addresses...")

    new_addresses <- new_addresses %>%
      geocode(
        address = full_address,
        method = "osm",
        lat = latitude,
        long = longitude
      )

    # Add new results to cache
    geocode_cache <<- bind_rows(
      geocode_cache,
      new_addresses
    ) %>%
      distinct(full_address, .keep_all = TRUE)

    # Save updated cache
    write_csv(geocode_cache, cache_file)
  }

  # Join cached coordinates back
  dat_geo <- dat %>%
    left_join(
      geocode_cache,
      by = "full_address"
    )

  # Write output
  output_file <- here(
    "data",
    "cleaned",
    "states-2024-streetgeo",
    paste0(
      tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file)),
      "-streetgeo.csv"
    )
  )

  write_csv(dat_geo, output_file)

  message("Finished: ", basename(file))
}

# Run for all files
walk(
  active_state_files,
  process_active_state_file_street
)
```

# Fix NAs
```{r}
# Manually went through an put correct addresses into geocode_cache.csv
# Read in 2024
processors_street <- read_csv(here("data/cleaned/states-2024-streetgeo/active-processors-2024-streetgeo.csv"))


# Create CSV with rows with NAs in lat and lon
missing_processors <- processors_street %>%
  filter(is.na(latitude) | is.na(longitude))

write_csv(
  missing_processors,
  here("data","cleaned", "processors_missing.csv")
)
```
 
```{r}
# Read in manually geocoded file
missing_processors_fixed <- read_csv(
  here("data/cleaned/processors_missing_geocodes.csv")
)

# Fill in only missing coordinates
processors_street <- processors_street %>%
  left_join(
    missing_processors_fixed %>%
      select(
        pp_idnum,
        latitude_new = latitude,
        longitude_new = longitude
      ),
    by = "pp_idnum"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    latitude = coalesce(latitude, latitude_new),
    longitude = coalesce(longitude, longitude_new)
  ) %>%
  select(-latitude_new, -longitude_new)

# Save updated dataset
write_csv(
  processors_street,
  here("data/cleaned/states-2024-streetgeo/active-processors-2024-streetgeo.csv")
)

# update geocache
geocode_cache <- read_csv(
  here("data/cleaned/geocode_cache.csv")
)

geocode_cache <- geocode_cache %>%
  left_join(
    missing_processors_fixed %>%
      select(full_address, latitude_new = latitude, longitude_new = longitude),
    by = "full_address"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    latitude = coalesce(latitude, latitude_new),
    longitude = coalesce(longitude, longitude_new)
  ) %>%
  select(-latitude_new, -longitude_new)

write_csv(
  geocode_cache,
  here("data/cleaned/geocode_cache.csv")
)
```






# Extend to past 10 years
```{r}
# Extend to past 10 years
products_14 <- products %>%
  filter(year >= 2014)

# Get unique processors that have product records since 2014
processors_14 <- products_14 %>%
  distinct(pp_idnum)

processors_14_address <- processors_14 %>%
  left_join(
    address_24,
    by = "pp_idnum"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    plant_zip = str_pad(
      as.character(plant_zip),
      width = 5,
      pad = "0"
    ),
    full_address = paste(
      plant_street,
      plant_city,
      plant_state_abrv,
      plant_zip,
      sep = ", "
    ),
    full_address = na_if(
      full_address,
      "NA, NA, NA, NA"
    )
  )


# Check for processors with no address information
processors_14_address %>%
  filter(is.na(full_address)) %>%
  select(pp_idnum)


# How many processors have product information since 2014?
nrow(processors_14)

# How many have an address?
processors_14_address %>%
  summarise(
    processors = n(),
    with_address = sum(!is.na(full_address)),
    without_address = sum(is.na(full_address))
  )


geocode_cache <- read_csv(
  here("data/cleaned/geocode_cache.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)



new_addresses <- processors_14_address %>%
  distinct(full_address) %>%
  filter(!is.na(full_address)) %>%
  anti_join(
    geocode_cache,
    by = "full_address"
  )

nrow(new_addresses)


if (nrow(new_addresses) > 0) {

  message(
    "Geocoding ",
    nrow(new_addresses),
    " new addresses..."
  )

  new_addresses <- new_addresses %>%
    geocode(
      address = full_address,
      method = "osm",
      lat = latitude,
      long = longitude
    )

  # Add new results to cache
  geocode_cache <- bind_rows(
    geocode_cache,
    new_addresses
  ) %>%
    distinct(full_address, .keep_all = TRUE)

  # Save updated cache
  write_csv(
    geocode_cache,
    here("data", "cleaned", "geocode_cache.csv")
  )
}


processors_14_geocoded <- processors_14_address %>%
  left_join(
    geocode_cache %>%
      select(
        full_address,
        latitude,
        longitude
      ),
    by = "full_address"
  )



write_csv(
  processors_14_geocoded,
  here(
    "data",
    "cleaned",
    "processors-2014-2024-geocoded.csv"
  )
)


```
